description: Search TechCrunch articles by keyword via the public WordPress REST API — the same corpus shown by the on-site search box (techcrunch.com/?s=...). Returns matching article cards with title, URL, date, excerpt, featured image, and category names, newest first (reverse-chronological; the on-site box ranks by relevance, the API returns the same posts ordered by date). Paginates internally up to the limit (max 100); partial=true when no more results exist. No authentication required.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keywords, e.g. "openai" or "spacex launch". Plain text; matches article titles and content, same as the on-site search box.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20). Paginates the API internally; partial=true when no more results exist.
